criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 1 May 2027 (12 months after the 1 May 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.3 is stated as $1,920,000 but 12% of the $20,000,000 Purchase Price is $2,400,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Calculates the long-stop date as 30 July 2026 (120 days after signing on 1 April 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 29 August 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $19,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $18,760,000 is wrong.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (12% x $20,000,000 = $2,400,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $1,920,000.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (1 May 2027), with days remaining from 10 April 2026 (386 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
